name: Treaty of Brest-Litovsk (1435)
summary: Following Polish-Lithuanian victory at the Battle of Wiłkomierz (Sept 1435), the Teutonic Order's Livonian branch signs a permanent peace with Poland-Lithuania. The treaty effectively ends Teutonic offensive capacity in Lithuania.

_quarry.structural_significance: Concludes a decade of war and stabilises the Polish-Lithuanian union's north-eastern frontier; the Order's military decline leads to the Thirteen Years' War (1454–66) and the Second Peace of Toruń.
